1.description: [Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Fixed a bug causing Explosive Shot to receive more Attack Power and Spell Power scaling than intended.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Holy Ranged abilities with a cast time can now trigger the Improved Judgements capstone.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Aimed Shot, Kill Shot, and Chimera Shot can now trigger Empowered Light.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Auto Shot can now trigger Stay Frosty.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Lunar Marksmanship]: During Lunar Eclipse, Arcane Shot has 50% reduced cooldown and 30% increased critical strike chance.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Penitent Reload]: Dealing damage with Penance grants charges that make your next Steady Shot instant, holding up to 3 charges.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Elemental Reload]: Dealing damage with Elemental Blast resets the cooldown of Chimera Shot.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Conductive Venom]: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning increase damage taken from your Serpent Sting by 15% per stack, up to 5 stacks, for 15 seconds.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Consecrated Target]: Ranged damage marks targets for 15 seconds, increasing damage taken from your Holy Fire by 10% per stack, up to 10 stacks. This effect is not consumed.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Arctic Stalker]: Aimed Shot and Steady Shot reduce Deep Freeze's remaining cooldown by 1 second.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] - Biting Drain now grants the periodic damage from your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells the ability to critically hit.

[Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Divine Concord]: The Art of War now also makes Arcane Blast instant cast.

[Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] Increased Vampirism's healing coefficient by 500%.

0.description: Updated the UI to be transparent so you can still see the auction list, draggable, and to have an actual header in the auction pop up menu.

Added UI rollback handling for in-game “item was not found” failures so UI spent/quantity totals are actually accurate. Previously, auctionator would just show that you spent gold when you really didn't.
Fixed quantity tracking to count actual stack quantity, not just number of auction rows.
There is now a purchase summary when using the chain buy feature that shows Bought x for: Y amount of gold/silver/copper.
Added the `Chain buy` feature. This allows you to continue to the buy items without having to open/close menus. This is a toggleable feature.
Fixed broken Auction House buying flow where only one purchase worked before needing to leave/re-enter the Auction House menu.
**Auctionator Changelog**
Mythic+ Champions are no longer required to complete your Keystone, they still provide high trash completion for killing.
Macros can now hold 511 characters up from 255.

[Pending Restart] - A Brand New Profession is now released - Woodworking. This profession allows you to take the wood that you chop, carve, and shape to be made into equipment like bucklers, spell tomes, staves, arrows, spears, polearms AND MORE. This does NOT occupy a primary profession slot and can be picked up alongside woodcutting and 2 primary professions.
[Area-52] - Mr. Muhn E. Bagz - The Very Rich Guy! Has returned to Area-52 with some new spoils!
Granted Everyone 2 Customization Potions on Login
If your launcher does not open this can be fixed by redownloading it from the website.
If your launcher is stuck updating, relaunch!
455 New Race Customizations have been added to all realms. Available now with a patch on the launcher. Have fun!
Meteor and Shards of Magic now stop triggering while players are dead, outside the Manastorm, still entering, or protected by the Manastorm safety bubble.
Fixed Shards of Magic - They now preserve their original ground location instead of retargeting directly ontop of you every tick.
Fixed the Manastorm Meteor affix so meteors now correctly land at the affected player’s position instead of misfiring always landing on the player.
Fixed an issue where Chop'gog the Butcher was not spawning properly in its Manastorm segment.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: The size of Time Keepers has been greatly reduced.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: The melee damage and health of Time Keepers have been greatly reduced on all difficulties to better align with the stats of enemy creatures.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: Time Keepers summoned to assist the player by Chrono-beacon now have a maximum lifetime of 1 minute and will follow the summoning player instead of walking in a random radius around their summon position. Time Keepers will now actively try to assist the summoning player, prioritizing the player’s attack target over other enemies.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: If all points on Medivh’s shield are lost, or all players are dead during an active boss encounter, the instance will now wipe the event, resulting in the death of all still living players. The event can be restarted from the last saved portal afterward.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: All attacking infinite dragonkin will now directly attack Medivh and will no longer become stuck if moved too far from Medivh’s position.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: Rift Keepers and Rift Lords will now move on their own to assault Medivh if not defeated within 3 minutes of spawning.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: There will now be a 15-second recovery time between rifts after closing them.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: Medivh will now take a break from summoning new portals after every boss. Talking to Medivh again will restart the event.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: The instance events are now started by talking to Medivh instead of automatically starting when a player approaches him.

[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: The instance will now save your progress, allowing you to restart from the last portal you successfully closed after a wipe, server restart, or server crash. Note that already closed portals will not award any loot or reputation.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: Added several quality-of-life functions.
[Pending Restart] [The Black Morass] [General]: Corrected multiple issues where the instance could become stuck or fail to progress.
